Class GenericTypeAwareAutowireCandidateResolver

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.beans.factory.support.SimpleAutowireCandidateResolver
org.springframework.beans.factory.support.GenericTypeAwareAutowireCandidateResolver
All Implemented Interfaces:
Cloneable, Aware, BeanFactoryAware, AutowireCandidateResolver
Direct Known Subclasses:
QualifierAnnotationAutowireCandidateResolver
public class GenericTypeAwareAutowireCandidateResolver extends SimpleAutowireCandidateResolver implements BeanFactoryAware, Cloneable
Basic AutowireCandidateResolver that performs a full generic type match with the candidate's type if the dependency is declared as a generic type (for example, Repository<Customer>).

这是 QualifierAnnotationAutowireCandidateResolver 的基类，在此级别提供了所有非基于注解的解析步骤的实现。

Since:
4.0
Author:
Jürgen Hoeller

    • setBeanFactory

      public void setBeanFactory(BeanFactory beanFactory)
      描述从接口复制：BeanFactoryAware
      Callback that supplies the owning factory to a bean instance.

      在普通 Bean 属性填充之后，但在初始化回调（例如 InitializingBean.afterPropertiesSet()）或自定义 init-method 之前调用。

      Specified by:
      `setBeanFactory` 接口 `BeanFactoryAware` 中
      Parameters:
      beanFactory - 拥有该 Bean 的 BeanFactory（永远不会为 null）。 该 Bean 可以立即调用工厂上的方法。
      See Also:
      • BeanInitializationException

    • isAutowireCandidate

      public boolean isAutowireCandidate(BeanDefinitionHolder bdHolder, DependencyDescriptor descriptor)
      描述从接口复制：AutowireCandidateResolver
      Determine whether the given bean definition qualifies as an autowire candidate for the given dependency.

      默认实现检查 BeanDefinition.isAutowireCandidate()。

      Specified by:
      `isAutowireCandidate` 接口 `AutowireCandidateResolver` 中
      Parameters:
      bdHolder - 包含 Bean 名称和别名的 Bean 定义
      descriptor - 目标方法参数或字段的描述符
      Returns:
      bean 定义是否作为自动注入候选者
      See Also:
      • BeanDefinition.isAutowireCandidate()
